about_the_game:
With a ferocious creature destroying entire dimensions without even trying, only the Dimensional Travelers are able to stand in it's way. Doller, a lazy apprentice Mage, is about to be sent on the adventure of a lifetime. Teaming up with the other Dimensional Travelers, Yeign; a Navish Warrior, Freia; a well mannered Demon Spawn, and Yosei; a Pixie Thief that will come at you if you call him a Fairy; and following the Commander's orders, can this misfit group really stop the destruction of the very fabric of the entire Universe? 

  • 5 World Maps 230 x 178 blocks large

  • Night and day cycles with the ability to beak into buildings

  • Different endings for the Dimensional Beast

  • Powerful storylines and character arcs causing dimensions to feel different

  • Working PC in the Airship Cabin that has apps and fully working games 

  • NPCs working and doing tasks making each world feel alive

  • Original Sound Track by composer Anthony Fusilier

Being a solo dev project by a professional sci-fi/fantasy writer, Dimensional Gates is the next amazing adventure you're set to experience. With hours and hours of gameplay, storylines, and battling enemies, you can feel the heart and soul that was placed into the making of this game well. 

* Game designed using RPG Maker MV Engine (screen freeze issues fixed)

detailed_description:
Demo Drop

Demo will be released September 2025. It contains the first chapter and a half and contains hours of entertainment. Demo save will work with game file. 


Digital Deluxe Edition

A Digital Deluxe Edition will also be available with original sound track by composer Anthony Fusilier, and detailed digital maps to dungeons and towns.
